activity_summary: You crossed the old reminder and wrote York naming the rights taken, and stopping when the breath stopped. You did not make a song of the seizure. The messenger stayed a mark. The deposition sheets stayed at the edge of the board. You did not open them, and you did not begin the prison or the end.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote York naming the rights, and stopped the speech where the breath stops.
